issue.title: sql: schema change jobs fail permanently with validation errors during upgrade
issue.body:
During the 23.1 upgrade roachtest, ALTER TABLE jobs fail with a descriptor validation error and are not retried. Before last week they retried and succeeded once the version gate finished.

Jira issue: CRDB-27711

comments.body: See #101200, which made validation errors permanent. I'll revert it.
Still not seeing this since the revert.
